## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: The new parent_status_uuid field written to state by process_status() is not initialized in make_initial_state() in _state.py. While the code safely defaults to empty string via state.get(), adding a field to state without declaring it in the canonical schema means future schema validators won't enumerate it.
